items.t: Engine stalls when fuel pump fuse blows (recall)
items.job: Reroute fuel tank temperature sensor harness or replace fuel pump assembly
items.note: Free under the recall at Nissan or Chevrolet dealers. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.
Free under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Ignition can slip to accessory and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Airbag light or Passenger Air Bag Off light stays on
items.note: RepairPal lists about $428-$537 for the same NV200 part. Some GM parts are discontinued; Nissan parts may fit.

items.t: CVT hesitation or shudder with transmission codes
items.job: CVT fluid change and transmission software update
items.note: Fluid change is about $160-$188 at RepairPal for the same van. A valve body or transmission costs far more.

items.t: CVT whine or noise from the transmission
items.note: Covers diagnosis only. Free if a campaign applies; CVT repairs otherwise can cost thousands.

items.t: Clicking from front axles when pulling away
items.job: Noise diagnosis, clean and grease axle-to-hub joint

items.t: Check engine light for EVAP leak
items.job: Replace EVAP vent valve O-ring, purge valve or fuel cap
items.note: RepairPal lists about $168-$242 for a purge valve on the same van.

items.t: Check engine light for air flow sensor (P0101)
items.note: Follow the Nissan bulletin before replacing the sensor.

items.t: Engine computer software update for emissions (Nissan campaign)
items.note: Free if your VIN is included in the Nissan emissions campaign; City Express coverage is not confirmed, so ask a dealer.

items.t: Check engine light with ECM code P0603
items.note: Covers diagnosis; a new battery or computer costs extra if needed.

items.t: Cranks but won't start after a freezing night
items.note: Free under the Chevrolet program if your VIN qualifies; diagnosis cost shown otherwise.
Same part as the Nissan NV200. RepairPal lists about $876-$916 for the NV200. Nissan bulletin NTB15-106 covers early vans; ask a dealer whether it applies.

items.t: Clunk from front strut tops when steering
items.job: Replace front strut mounts or struts
items.note: Same parts as the Nissan NV200. RepairPal lists about $1,448-$1,711 for strut replacement on the NV200; mount-only repairs cost less.

items.t: A/C water leaks into the center console
items.job: Console insulator / airbag control unit service campaign
items.note: Free at a dealer if your VIN is in the Nissan campaign. No independent repair price found.

items.t: Key won't come out or shifter stuck in Park
items.job: Replace brake light switch or adjust key interlock cable
items.note: RepairPal lists about $78-$111 for a brake light switch on the same van; cable adjustment alone may cost less.
RepairPal lists about $516-$573 for the same NV200 part.
Same battery as the Nissan NV200 (YourMechanic NV200 estimate).
